summary: The chip plan was scored against the stored empty-chip climbs on 2022/23, 2023/24, and 2025/26. All 12 squads finished. 2022/23, on the 2026 wallet, loses on every squad; the best lift is Third at -40. 2023/24's best lift is Third at +128, and the highest chip total is Template at 2090, 15 below its empty climb. 2025/26, the matched wallet, gains on every squad; the best lift is Template at +199 and the highest chip total is Premium at 2214. Every squad wildcards in Gameweek 4, the first week the buy pool exists. Hits on the 2025/26 chip climbs are 0. The published climb is unchanged.
